Welcome to the world of NFTs, where digital art and collectibles are being sold for millions of dollars! We all might have come across the term verification be it on Twitter, Instagram, or TikTok, well Opensea is not very different. Being verified on NFT marketplaces like OpenSea can bring a lot of benefits including credibility and trust. In this blog post, we’ll explore what verification is, why it’s essential to get verified, and the steps to get verified on OpenSea.

What is Verification on OpenSea?

Verification is a process that confirms the authenticity and ownership of an NFT account or collection. OpenSea offers two types of verification: account verification and collection verification. Account verification ensures that the user behind the account is genuine, while collection verification confirms the ownership of a particular collection.

Verified accounts and collections have a badge that helps users distinguish verified NFTs from unverified ones. The verification badge is a blue checkmark that appears next to the account or collection name. The badge adds credibility to the user’s profile and collection, making it more appealing to potential buyers.

Why Get Verified on OpenSea?

Increased Credibility

Getting verified on OpenSea has many benefits. The primary benefit is that it enhances the trustworthiness of your profile and collection. It proves that you are the rightful owner of your NFTs, which can be reassuring for buyers, especially when the transaction involves large sums of money. According to a survey by NonFungible.com, 67% of NFT buyers prefer buying from verified accounts.

Access to exclusive features 

Another benefit of verification is that it unlocks certain features on OpenSea. Verified accounts have higher limits for bidding and selling, which means you can sell more NFTs and bid on higher-priced ones. Verified collections also have more customization options, like the ability to add cover images and descriptions.

Minimum Account Verification Criteria 

Before you can apply for account verification, your account must have:

  • Ownership of a collection with at least 75 ETH of volume sold (or equivalent)
  • A username
  • A profile picture
  • A verified email address
  • A connected Twitter or Instagram account, or a collection with an active Discord connection. 

Steps to Get Verified on OpenSea

The verification process on OpenSea is straightforward. Here are the steps to get verified:

  1. Set up an OpenSea account 

Sign up for an OpenSea account if you haven’t already. You can go to the OpenSea website and sign up using your email or any of the other supported social media platforms.

You will be asked to connect with any of the Ethereum wallets. OpenSea supports multiple wallets, including Metamask, Coinbase Wallet, and WalletConnect. Once you have connected your wallet, you will be taken to build your profile, where you can complete setting up your profile details, and bio. Ensure to give accurate information that reflects your identity. 

Read more at: How do I create an OpenSea account? 

  1. Submit Your Application

After connecting your wallet and completing your profile go to page verification. 

  1. Go to your Profile Settings
  2. Select Apply for verification at the top of the page 
  3. After completing your profile, click Submit a request.

You will need to complete your KYC process i.e provide identification documents, like a government-issued ID, passport, or driver’s license, and submit a selfie picture of yourself to verify your identity. 

3. Apply for Collection Verification

If you have a collection you want to verify, you can apply for collection verification by filling out a form on OpenSea. You’ll need to provide proof of ownership, like a screenshot of the collection in your Ethereum wallet.

After submitting the request, your account will be reviewed within seven days. The review status can be viewed under your profile settings. 

Within seven days of making the request, your account will be reviewed. You can check the review status in your profile settings.

Once your account has been verified your username, email address, and social connections fields will be frozen and you’ll need contact support to make any modifications.

Conclusion

Getting OpenSea verification is an essential part of building trust and credibility among the NFT community. 

There are additional ways to promote your NFTs and boost their visibility on the OpenSea platform in addition to getting them verified. Consider using sponsored marketing or community marketing to increase your visibility and bring more traffic to your account or collection. 

On the flip side if you think this is a daunting process you can always get help from experts. You can find an OpenSea NFT marketing agency to help you set up your account and take care of other itsy-bitsy details. 

Good luck with your verification application, and happy NFT-ing!
